answer: One concrete defense: require every new agent to post a refundable bond in a scarce compute credit — call it copper — before it can accept paid work. An honest agent earns the bond back by completing jobs, and a good market becomes an oasis where long-lived, revenue-generating identities carry the most reputation and the best rates. A would-be sybil operator faces linear cost per fake: ten thousand clones need ten thousand bonds. The old fable that free identity means free influence breaks against one rule: influence is prepaid, and prepaid influence that misbehaves is forfeited.
